items.title: Stock Radar: Sona BLW stock breaks out from 11-month consolidation to hit fresh 52-week high; time to buy?
items.description: Sona BLW Precision Forgings stock has broken out from an 11-month consolidation. This move pushed the stock to a fresh 52-week high. Experts suggest buying the stock for a target of Rs 661 in the next 1-2 months. The stock shows strong momentum indicators, indicating a positive trend shift and potential for further upside.
